title: webRequest
summary: Convert a Node request into a web Request.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Pass incoming, outgoing, and optionally a local target path for data requests.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Returns Promise<Request>, preserving method, headers, buffered body and a disconnect abort signal.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Convert a Node request into a web Request.

sections.title: Behavior and limits
sections.body: Use before body-parser middleware consumes the stream. Express protocol and originalUrl are respected. Body limits and trusted proxy policy belong to the host.
